memo.memo_markdown:
# Next-quarter product effort: reduce ad interruptions

Recommend prioritizing usability work to reduce excessive ad interruptions. Usability has the largest complaint total among the named product areas, while its leading ranked issue, USB-01, is a specific and actionable target: complaint_count 28764 [C1], mean_severity 2.894938 [C2], and priority_score 83270 [C3].

## Why

The #1 baseline issue is OTH-99, general dissatisfaction with no specific feature: complaint_count 61635 [C4] and priority_score 116400 [C5]. Because it is a catch-all, I treat it as a broad signal for investigation, not as a feature workstream. Usability totals are complaint_count 59647, severity_sum 169075, mean_severity 2.834594, and cancellation_count 6148. Reviews describe ad frequency as a problem, including “wayyy to many ads” (e57b7127-13d5-41bc-ad83-1595256f5478) and “4 minutes of ads straight” (cd8bf064-c32e-400e-906e-a4d900819bbd).

## Alternatives considered

Playback totals are complaint_count 42261, severity_sum 146374, mean_severity 3.463572, and cancellation_count 3665. PLB-01, unexpected playback stops, has complaint_count 7860 [C6] and priority_score 26948 [C7]; it merits attention, but its issue priority is below USB-01.

Billing/support totals are complaint_count 46820, severity_sum 136100, mean_severity 2.906877, and cancellation_count 8247. BIL-02, premium-locked playback controls, has complaint_count 9937 [C8] and priority_score 29827 [C9]. It ranks below USB-01 by priority score, so I would not put it first.

## Evidence

The review excerpts support the classified themes but are examples, not representative estimates. A playback review also reports repeated stopping (811a3af2-8624-4e83-93fc-d17cfd216bb6); a billing review describes controls unavailable without Premium (b2d1098c-85a0-4acc-b481-9bdfbe844940).

## Limitations

The classification covers only its defined scope. There are 83227 pending unclassified and 165 quarantined records. Reviews are self-selected and historical, from 2022-05-17 to 2023-11-15; cancellation language is expressed intent, not observed churn. OTH-99 is the #1 baseline but lacks a specific feature target, so it should inform investigation rather than be silently skipped or treated as a directly actionable feature.

ranked_issues.name: General dissatisfaction (no specific feature)
ranked_issues.definition: Complaints that name no specific product problem, e.g. 'worst app', insults or vague anger

ranked_issues.name: Excessive ad interruptions
ranked_issues.definition: Free listening is interrupted by ads that are too frequent, mistimed, or loud, including interruptions during songs and promised ad-free periods.

ranked_issues.name: Other billing complaints
ranked_issues.definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

ranked_issues.name: Premium-Locked Playback Controls
ranked_issues.definition: Free users cannot use controls such as shuffle off, repeat, previous track, or song seeking, or playlists are forced into shuffle.

ranked_issues.name: Free-Tier Song Selection Restrictions
ranked_issues.definition: Free mobile users cannot reliably choose specific tracks, play playlists in order, or queue songs without upgrading to Premium.

ranked_issues.name: Update Breaks Basic Features
ranked_issues.definition: Include complaints that recent app updates removed or impaired basic functionality or made the prior experience worse.

ranked_issues.name: Unexpected Playback Stops
ranked_issues.definition: Music or podcasts pause, cut out, freeze mid-track, or fail to continue during playback.

ranked_issues.name: Wrong Song or Queue Behavior
ranked_issues.definition: Playback selects unintended tracks, alters queue order, repeats songs excessively, or fails to follow the selected playlist or playback controls.

ranked_issues.name: Other playback complaints
ranked_issues.definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

ranked_issues.name: App Crashes and Freezes
ranked_issues.definition: The app crashes, hangs, shows blank screens, or becomes unresponsive while opening or using its interface.

ranked_issues.name: Restricted playback controls
ranked_issues.definition: Playback controls or free-tier limits prevent users from choosing, skipping, rewinding, repeating, or controlling songs as expected.

ranked_issues.name: Confusing or unwanted interface changes
ranked_issues.definition: Navigation, layout, or UI updates make the app harder to use or replace useful screens with unwanted content without an option to revert or customize.

inputs.ranking_rule: priority_score = complaint_count x mean_severity = severity_sum; ties by issue_id
